meaning.en: Extremely difficult.
meaning.zh: 比登天还难，形容极其困难。

examples.zh: 在这个行业出头，真是难于上青天。
examples.en: Making a name in this industry is harder than climbing to heaven.

examples.zh: 要说服他，简直难于上青天。
examples.en: Persuading him is next to impossible.

story.en: Li Bai's 'The Road to Shu is Hard': 'The road to Shu is hard, harder than climbing to the blue sky' (蜀道之难，难于上青天).
story.zh: 李白《蜀道难》：“噫吁嚱，危乎高哉！蜀道之难，难于上青天！”

meaning.en: Known even to women and children; common knowledge.
meaning.zh: 连妇女和小孩都知道，形容人人皆知。

examples.zh: 这个故事妇孺皆知。
examples.en: This story is known to everyone.

examples.zh: 他的名字在当地妇孺皆知。
examples.en: His name is a household word in the area.

natural: handle a heavy task with ease

meaning.en: To handle a difficult matter as easily as lifting something light.
meaning.zh: 举起很重的东西像举轻东西一样，比喻做难事毫不费力。

examples.zh: 他举重若轻地解决了这场纠纷。
examples.en: He settled the dispute with great ease.

examples.zh: 大师写文章举重若轻。
examples.en: The master writes on weighty subjects with a light touch.

antonyms: 拿着鸡毛当令箭——小题大做

meaning.en: To say all one knows, holding nothing back.
meaning.zh: 知道的就全部说出来，毫无保留。

examples.zh: 对于这件事，我知无不言。
examples.en: On this matter I'll tell you everything I know.

examples.zh: 专家们知无不言，回答了所有问题。
examples.en: The experts held nothing back in answering every question.

meaning.en: To wait for a good offer; of talent, to wait for the right post.
meaning.zh: 等待好价钱才卖；比喻等待时机出来任职，或等待更好的条件。

equivalents: hold out for the right price

examples.zh: 好球员待价而沽，等着最高的报价。
examples.en: The star player is waiting for the best offer.

examples.zh: 他待价而沽，没有急于接受第一份工作。
examples.en: He is holding out for a better offer and didn't rush into the first job.

story.en: Zigong asked whether to hide a jade or sell it; Confucius said, 'Sell it! Sell it! I am waiting for a buyer' (沽之哉！沽之哉！我待贾者也).
story.zh: 《论语》：“沽之哉！沽之哉！我待贾者也。”

meaning.en: Speech or writing with real content.
meaning.zh: 说话或写文章有实在的内容。

examples.zh: 他的演讲言之有物，很有说服力。
examples.en: His talk had substance and was persuasive.

examples.zh: 写文章要言之有物，不要空话连篇。
examples.en: Writing should have substance, not empty phrases.

story.en: Book of Changes: 'A gentleman's words have substance, and his conduct has constancy' (君子以言有物，而行有恒).
story.zh: 《周易》：“君子以言有物，而行有恒。”

date.zh: 西周至战国 · 前9—前3世纪
date.en: Western Zhou to Warring States, 9th–3rd c. BC

usage.en: Predicate; often with 言之有序.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“言之有序”连用。

meaning.en: Speaking with justice on one's side and firm words.
meaning.zh: 理由正当，措辞严正。

examples.zh: 发言人义正词严地驳斥了谣言。
examples.en: The spokesman rebutted the rumours with righteous firmness.

examples.zh: 她义正词严，对方无言以对。
examples.en: Her words were just and stern, leaving her opponent speechless.

meaning.en: Changing erratically.
meaning.zh: 变化不定，没有规律。

examples.zh: 山区的天气变化无常。
examples.en: Weather in the mountains is unpredictable.

examples.zh: 他脾气变化无常，很难相处。
examples.en: His moods are erratic and he's hard to get on with.

meaning.en: Towering up into the clouds.
meaning.zh: 形容建筑物或山峰非常高。

examples.zh: 远处是高耸入云的雪山。
examples.en: In the distance are snow peaks towering into the clouds.

examples.zh: 市中心的摩天大楼高耸入云。
examples.en: Skyscrapers soar into the clouds in the city centre.

natural: blaze a trail through the mountains

meaning.en: To cut a road when you meet a mountain; to overcome every obstacle.
meaning.zh: 遇到山就开路，比喻不怕困难，勇往直前。

equivalents: cut a way through every obstacle

examples.zh: 探险队逢山开路，遇水架桥。
examples.en: The expedition cut paths through mountains and bridged rivers.

examples.zh: 创业就要有逢山开路的精神。
examples.en: Starting a business needs the spirit of cutting a path through every obstacle.

usage.en: Usually paired with 遇水搭桥.

meaning.en: A place where cultural figures and heritage gather.
meaning.zh: 指某地人才和文化汇聚。

equivalents: a hub of culture and talent

examples.zh: 江南自古人文荟萃。
examples.en: The Jiangnan region has long been a hub of culture and talent.

examples.zh: 这座古城人文荟萃，名人辈出。
examples.en: The old city is a cultural centre that has produced many famous people.

meaning.en: To find enjoyment in the midst of hardship.
meaning.zh: 在困苦中自找乐趣。

equivalents: make the best of a bad situation

examples.zh: 加班到深夜，大家苦中作乐，讲起笑话来。
examples.en: Working late into the night, we cheered ourselves up with jokes.

examples.zh: 他在艰难的日子里苦中作乐。
examples.en: He found small joys during the hard days.

meaning.en: Neither related nor acquainted.
meaning.zh: 既不是亲戚，也不是老朋友，毫无关系。

examples.zh: 我们非亲非故，他为什么要帮我？
examples.en: We're neither related nor friends. Why would he help me?

examples.zh: 她与老人非亲非故，却照顾了他多年。
examples.en: Though unrelated to the old man, she cared for him for years.

meaning.en: Head held high and chest thrust out; confident bearing.
meaning.zh: 抬起头，挺起胸，形容精神饱满、充满自信。

examples.zh: 运动员昂首挺胸走进赛场。
examples.en: The athletes marched into the arena with their heads held high.

examples.zh: 做人要昂首挺胸，不卑不亢。
examples.en: Hold your head high and be neither servile nor haughty.

pinyin: cōng míng fǎn bèi cōng míng wù

meaning.en: Being undone by one's own cleverness.
meaning.zh: 自以为聪明，结果反被自己的聪明所误。

examples.zh: 他耍小聪明，结果聪明反被聪明误。
examples.en: He tried to be smart and ended up outsmarting himself.

examples.zh: 别太自负，小心聪明反被聪明误。
examples.en: Don't be too self-assured or you'll be too clever by half.

synonyms: 机关算尽太聪明，反算了卿卿性命

story.en: In a poem for his newborn son, Su Shi wrote 'Everyone raises a son hoping he'll be clever; I was ruined all my life by cleverness' (我被聪明误一生), hoping instead his child would be dull and rise to high office without trouble. The saying 聪明反被聪明误 distils this.
story.zh: 苏轼《洗儿》：“人皆养子望聪明，我被聪明误一生。惟愿孩儿愚且鲁，无灾无难到公卿。”后概括为“聪明反被聪明误”。

natural: as if by some unseen hand

meaning.en: As if driven by supernatural forces; doing something inexplicable.
meaning.zh: 好像有鬼神在支使，指不由自主地做出意料之外的事。

equivalents: as if by some unseen hand

examples.zh: 我鬼使神差地走进了那家书店。
examples.en: As if drawn by some force I walked into that bookshop.

examples.zh: 鬼使神差，他竟买了那张彩票。
examples.en: Inexplicably, he bought that lottery ticket.

meaning.en: To keep crying out in distress.
meaning.zh: 不停地叫苦，形容处境艰难或不满。

examples.zh: 连续加班让员工叫苦连天。
examples.en: Constant overtime has the staff groaning.

examples.zh: 物价上涨，百姓叫苦连天。
examples.en: With prices soaring, ordinary people are complaining bitterly.

meaning.en: The overall situation is lost beyond recovery.
meaning.zh: 整个局势已经无法挽回。

equivalents: the writing is on the wall

examples.zh: 敌军士气低落，大势已去。
examples.en: With the enemy's morale low, their cause was lost.

examples.zh: 公司连年亏损，大势已去。
examples.en: After years of losses, the company was beyond saving.

meaning.en: There is no oddity that does not exist.
meaning.zh: 什么奇怪的事都有。

equivalents: there's no end of strange things

examples.zh: 世界之大，无奇不有。
examples.en: The world is so big that nothing is too odd to exist.

examples.zh: 网络上的新闻真是无奇不有。
examples.en: The stories online are truly bizarre.

meaning.en: To work together with one heart and combined strength.
meaning.zh: 齐心协力，团结一致。

examples.zh: 全国人民戮力同心，共渡难关。
examples.en: The whole nation pulled together to weather the crisis.

examples.zh: 只要戮力同心，就没有克服不了的困难。
examples.en: If we pull together, no difficulty is insurmountable.

meaning.en: A leading figure in founding a state.
meaning.zh: 创建国家的首要功臣。

examples.zh: 他是共和国的开国元勋之一。
examples.en: He was one of the founding fathers of the republic.

examples.zh: 纪念馆陈列着开国元勋的遗物。
examples.en: The memorial hall displays relics of the founding fathers.

meaning.en: Groundless, malicious gossip.
meaning.zh: 没有根据的、中伤别人的话。

examples.zh: 她不理会那些流言蜚语。
examples.en: She ignored the malicious gossip.

examples.zh: 流言蜚语让他备受困扰。
examples.en: The rumours and slander troubled him greatly.

meaning.en: To yield and compromise to keep the peace or protect an interest.
meaning.zh: 勉强迁就，以求保全；有时指为顾全大局而忍让。

equivalents: swallow one's pride to keep the peace

examples.zh: 为了家庭和睦，她一直委曲求全。
examples.en: For the sake of family harmony she kept making concessions.

examples.zh: 谈判时不能一味委曲求全。
examples.en: You can't simply yield at every turn in negotiations.

natural: choose the worthy and appoint the able

meaning.en: To choose people of virtue and ability for office.
meaning.zh: 选拔有德有才的人，委以职务。

examples.zh: 治理国家要选贤任能。
examples.en: Running a country demands choosing the worthy and able.

examples.zh: 公司选贤任能，不论资历。
examples.en: The firm promotes on merit regardless of seniority.
